wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap relation 1475937 fixes the convent perimeter and four courtyard openings. Church way 104218383 fixes the attached nave and southwest bell tower footprint. The local model follows the photographed east frontage.
lodDetails: Every level retains the mapped convent envelope, four courtyard openings, attached church, and bell tower. Nearer levels restore cloister openings, cornice trim, cross and clock details.
limitations: The January 2011 Qualla exterior fixes the church’s ochre detailing, three bays, steep bell tower spire and front pediment. The photo documents the building long after its nineteenth-century additions.
The whole linked range follows the mapped exterior and all four open courtyards. Secondary elevations, roof divisions, individual cloister bays, and precise heights are proportional estimates.

The 128 m source field and local church-entry datum remain unmodified. Local thresholds and grading are approximate. The adjacent battlefield, museum interiors and separately managed structures are outside this model.
